title: Kanlaon volcano Alert Level 2: 7 ash emissions, SO2 1,154 t/d, edifice inflation (Philippines)
snippet: PHIVOLCS reports Kanlaon at Alert Level 2 (Increased Unrest): 7 ash emission events, 19 volcanic earthquakes, 6 tremors, plume 800m, SO2 1,154 t/d, edifice inflation detected. Also: Mayon Alert 3 with lava flows at Basud 3.8km, Bonga 3.2km, Mi-isi 1.6km; SO2 2,184 t/d.
tag_reason: 이전 14일 소스에 Kanlaon 2026-05 활동 없음. Alert Level 2 + 1,154 t/d SO2는 유의미한 신규 EO 이벤트.

entities.name: Kanlaon 화산 Alert Level 2 — 7 ash emissions, SO2 1,154 t/d
